problem.title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
problem.source: Official LeetCode problem page; Chinese explanation independently paraphrased
facts: Return node values level by level, left to right within each level.
The number of nodes is in [0,2000].

claims.claim: At the beginning of each outer iteration, the queue contains exactly the unprocessed nodes at one depth.
claims.validation: BFS queue invariant and fixed level_size.

claims.claim: Processing exactly the initial queue length prevents newly enqueued children from being consumed in the same level.
Every node enters and leaves the queue once, so time is O(n); the queue holds at most O(w) nodes where w is maximum tree width.
claims.validation: Queue operation count and frontier bound.
